$comment: Curated Agent Skills manifest for the newsroom-agent-kit. Default install = the 'core' and 'vendor' sections (37 skills). The 'optional' and 'needsReview' sections are documented but not installed. Canonical destination is %USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills. Nothing here is installed yet; Phase 4 applies it.

userContext.role: community manager and content producer for a media outlet
userContext.note: The platform list comes from the user. It is why the eight platform skills in the 'vendor' section were selected and why no LinkedIn skill was taken.

installPolicy.vendorSkills: A fork maintained in this repository under vendor/skills/<name>. Upstream text was rewritten to remove third-party product assumptions (SEC-07). Each vendored skill carries a PROVENANCE.md. Never overwrite a vendored copy with an upstream copy.
installPolicy.fetchSkills: Copied verbatim from the commit pinned in source.ref. The installer never executes an upstream install script.

selectionCriteria: Permissive license with an explicit LICENSE file at the pinned ref, or an explicit license field in SKILL.md frontmatter. One documented exception: og-image, accepted by the user on 2026-10-04.
Instruction-only for the core: no scripts, hooks, binaries or MCP tool requirements.
No API key, account or paid service needed for core behavior.
Portable Agent Skills layout, no vendor-locked paths.
Distinct job; no two default-install skills compete for the same trigger.
Fits an editorial / media-outlet workflow rather than SaaS growth.

core.name: newsroom-style
core.purpose: AP Style and newsroom conventions when writing news, editing drafts, writing headlines or tightening copy.

core.name: source-verification
core.purpose: Verify sources, claims, images, video, documents, interviews and synthetic media with SIFT and an evidence trail.

core.name: fact-check-workflow
core.purpose: Structured pre-publication fact-checking: claim rating and verification gates.

core.name: editorial-workflow
core.purpose: Newsroom assignments, deadlines and editorial calendars.

core.name: ai-writing-detox
core.purpose: Remove AI writing patterns that erode reader trust in articles, docs and press releases.

core.name: accessibility-compliance
core.purpose: WCAG patterns for news and academic sites: audits, alt text, accessible data visualization, assistive technology.

core.name: seo
core.purpose: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data, Core Web Vitals and content strategy.
core.notes: Only this single-file directory is taken from a 4241-file repository.

core.name: web-design-guidelines
core.purpose: Lightweight review pass for UI code against Web Interface Guidelines, including accessibility and UX.
core.notes: Preferred over the unlicensed vercel-labs original (SEC-03).

core.name: caption-writer-sms
core.purpose: Platform-specific captions for visual-first platforms: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube.

core.name: thread-writer-sms
core.purpose: Thread craft for text-first platforms: LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky.

core.name: carousel-writer-sms
core.purpose: Slide-by-slide carousel craft for visual-first platforms.

core.name: og-image
core.purpose: Social preview images (Open Graph) at 1200x630 built from the site's existing design system, plus the meta tags.
core.licenseRiskNote: The upstream repository has no LICENSE file, so default copyright applies and there is no grant of redistribution rights. The user was shown this and explicitly accepted the risk on 2026-10-04. Re-evaluate if upstream ever adds a license. Producing the images needs a headless browser.

core.name: hallmark
core.purpose: Anti-AI-slop design for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots.
core.notes: Promoted from optional to default at the user's request. No executable code. Upstream says it is powered by Together AI, but a full-text search found no API key, endpoint or network requirement: branding only. SKILL.md is ~9.8k words, so it is heavy when activated.

vendor.name: impeccable
vendor.purpose: Production-grade frontend design: design, redesign, critique, audit, polish, typography, layout, color, motion, accessibility, responsive behavior, design systems.
vendor.forkNote: Vendored as SKILL.md plus the 41 reference files. The scripts/ directory, the four .toml sub-agent files and the hook and live-browser surface are deliberately excluded: the launcher downloads a binary on first run (SEC-05). The 18 other vendor copies of this same skill in the upstream repository are never installed (SEC-11).

vendor.name: frontend-design
vendor.purpose: Context-fit frontend interfaces with deliberate art direction, accessible interaction, responsive behavior, complete states, and an accessibility checklist.
vendor.forkNote: Vendored as SKILL.md, references/ and the license and notice files. scripts/contrast-checker.py is excluded so the installed set contains zero executable files. The checker is Python stdlib only and can be reinstated later if Python is present.

optional.reason: Browser-driven QA of live pages and published output. Cross-agent value but needs a browser runtime, so not default.

optional.name: goals-and-kpis
optional.reason: Sets targets, which analytics-and-reporting deliberately leaves out. Reachable from 11 vendored skills.

optional.name: scheduling-and-queue
optional.reason: The single most-referenced uninstalled sibling (30 references). Covers scheduling and the confirmation contract. Deliberately not in the default set to limit trigger clutter; add it if scheduling becomes painful.

optional.name: profile-optimization
optional.reason: Profile fundamentals. Reachable from 10 vendored skills.

optional.name: story-pitch
optional.reason: Story pitches and query letters. Only useful for external pitching.

optional.name: social-media-intelligence
optional.reason: Narrative tracking and account vetting. Large, and adjacent to OSINT the user may not want globally.

optional.name: writing-style-and-tone
optional.reason: Social style edit passes. Overlaps ai-writing-detox.

optional.name: page-monitoring
optional.reason: Genuinely relevant to a newsroom, but requires a paid change-detection API and pip.

needsReview.name: accessibility-audit
needsReview.reason: Requires AccessLint MCP tools in allowed-tools, so it is inert without an external service. The repository also has no LICENSE file. Superseded for now by accessibility-compliance.

rejected.reason: Installs OpenCode skills to ~/.config/opencode/skills, breaking the canonical layout. Default symlink install fails on this machine. Ships telemetry. Requires absent Node.
No LICENSE file; package.json private with no license field. Both are thin pointers that fetch an external handbook at runtime.
Mega-bundle: 4241 files, 1006 code files, 1027 SKILL.md, plus hooks, MCP configs and Docker. Only skills/seo is taken.
248 skills, mostly cloud and AI-training oriented. Two directories extracted.
62 skills, 724 code files, hooks, plugins, services. Also the seed was wrong: it has neither fact-check nor content-calendar.
SaaS and product-marketing frame. Its social skill is named 'social', not 'social-content', and triggers overlap the selected social skills.
Frontmatter requires SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY, a paid API.
Routes to an SEO CLI and MCP server; 1148 code files for one instruction skill.
Every skill requires the AccessLint MCP server; no LICENSE file.
Every plugin is executable TypeScript inside Cline; jev-browser manages external credentials.
Deliberate redundancy control: one calendar and one hook implementation only.

knownGaps: CMS and editorial publishing workflows: deliberately out of scope. The user confirmed they are not needed. No WordPress-specific or generic CMS skill was selected.
Translation and localization: deliberately out of scope per the user. No portable candidate was found in the sources reviewed.
WhatsApp and Telegram: the user uses them, but no portable, license-clean skill was found. email-and-newsletter covers the owned-channel case. Revisit if this becomes painful.

About 45 sibling skills referenced by the vendored set are not installed. The global AGENTS.md instructs the agent to treat those references as unavailable and to do the work itself rather than inventing content.
